description: This file defines the MessageService interface for handling messaging functionalities within the OpenMRS project. It includes method signatures for sending, creating, and preparing messages, as well as managing message templates. The interface facilitates dependency injection for message sending mechanisms and message preparation components.

classes.name: MessageService
classes.description: Interface defining messaging operations such as sending messages, creating messages, and managing templates.

methods.name: setMessageSender
methods.description: Sets the MessageSender dependency for the service.

methods.name: getMessageSender
methods.description: Retrieves the current MessageSender used by the service.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Various overloads for sending messages to users, roles, or collections of users.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates new Message instances with specified parameters.

methods.name: prepareMessage
methods.description: Prepares a Message from a template or template name and data.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a message template by its ID.

methods.name: getTemplatesByName
methods.description: Retrieves templates matching the specified name.
